verdict.rationale: The docs only show single-item CLI/API operations (add/search/list/update/delete) and the Memory Export feature, which does create structured exports across memories in one call, hinting at some bulk export capability — but there is no documented bulk add, bulk delete/update, or batch API endpoint for operating on many items at once. missing for 10: explicit batch add/update/delete API, evidence of bulk operation limits or performance, independent confirmation of large-scale bulk usage.
